load_model_from_checkpoint: load a Chameleon Transformer model from a checkpoint directory using params.json and consolidated weights
detect_shard_count_for_model: detect the number of checkpoint shards in a Chameleon model directory by counting consolidated files
convert_checkpoint_to_transformer: convert a consolidated checkpoint file into a Transformer model instance with bfloat16 precision
get_checkpoint_path_by_rank: get the correct consolidated checkpoint file path for a given rank in a sharded model directory
load_model_with_specific_rank: load a Chameleon Transformer model from a specific shard rank in a multi-shard checkpoint directory
